entries.title: Airflow 3.3.2 tightens backfill endpoint authorization behavior
entries.summary: Backfill routes now avoid exposing whether backfill IDs exist across DAGs by returning consistent not-found behavior for inaccessible or unknown IDs.
entries.impact: Operational/API behavior changed around backfill authorization. Core TaskFlow, dynamic mapping and data-interval patterns remain valid.

entries.title: Kubernetes 1.37 released
entries.summary: Kubernetes 1.37 ships 67 enhancements: 16 graduating to Stable, 23 to Beta, 27 entering Alpha, plus one deprecation/removal.
entries.impact: The AtlasCode probe/resource/deployment fundamentals remain evergreen; version-specific feature adoption should be checked against the 1.37 changelog before use.

entries.title: Docker Engine 29.8.1 released
entries.summary: The patch includes containerd image-store, logging, user-namespace, Windows hard-link and networking fixes, and updates static containerd binaries to 2.3.5.
entries.impact: No AtlasCode core Docker pattern changes are required; this is primarily a maintenance release.

entries.title: Docker Engine 29.8 adds container process umask configuration
entries.summary: docker create and docker run gained a --umask option backed by HostConfig.Umask for the main process, execs and healthchecks.
entries.impact: Useful when file-mode defaults matter inside a container; it does not change the multi-stage, healthcheck or volume patterns already taught.

entries.title: Apache Spark 4.2.0 released
entries.summary: Apache announced the stable Spark 4.2.0 release after the 4.2 preview cycle, alongside maintained 4.1.x, 4.0.x and 3.5.x lines.
entries.impact: Treat 4.2 as a release-line update: verify migration notes and behavior changes before upgrading production jobs. Core plan, partition, cache and join mental models remain applicable.

entries.title: FastAPI 0.141.1 fixes frontend dependency background-task/header handling
entries.summary: The release fixes support for background tasks and headers coming from dependencies when using app.frontend().
entries.impact: The general BackgroundTasks pattern is unchanged; this matters specifically when background tasks or headers flow through frontend dependencies.

entries.title: FastAPI 0.141 adds app.frontend(check_dir="auto")
entries.summary: FastAPI added an app.frontend(check_dir="auto") option intended to make local frontend development more convenient with fastapi dev.
entries.impact: This is additive and does not change the route/dependency/response-model patterns in AtlasCode.
